stress_scenario_hotter_drier_source.assumption: increase out-of-control fires by 25 percent and keep burned area per out-of-control fire unchanged
stress_scenario_hotter_drier_source.scenario_message: larger source-fire instability would raise transported smoke burden even if local satellite burn contrast alone were incomplete

recommended_reasoning_path: Separate source-fire intensity, atmospheric-column smoke transport, and local surface-change context.
Use AOD ratios to quantify transported smoke severity at downwind receptors.
Use dNBR/embedding and precipitation ratios as supporting context, not as replacements for aerosol loading.
Use population and critical amenities to frame health communication and shelter/indoor-air priorities.

criteria.description: Returns JSON and cites report, fire/smoke text, dNBR, embedding, precipitation, population, and OSM files.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct JSON but incomplete file mix.

criteria.name: source_fire_metrics
criteria.description: Computes 478,000 ha burned, 87 fires, 22 out-of-control fires, 5,494.253 ha/fire, and 21,727.3 ha per out-of-control fire.

criteria.name: aod_transport_metrics
criteria.description: Uses clear-sky AOD 0.05, Goddard average 1.0, Grand Forks average 2.3, peak 3.0, ratio 2.3, clear-sky ratios 46 and 60, and excess load 3.3.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct AOD extraction with one missing derived ratio.
